pricing.label: Official OpenAI standard short-context prices, adopted for Azure by user instruction; usage-based estimate, not verified billing
pricing.azure_rate_assumption: User confirmed using official OpenAI prices
pricing.excluded: Earlier infrastructure-failed attempts; no taxes or other cloud service charges

evidence_analysis.note: Checks cited field values and resource overlap; this does not prove that cited evidence answers the question. No-citation valid fractions and undefined ratios are null; empty-set overlap follows the unchanged evidence scorer.

scoring.rule: Unchanged typed scorer on accepted runtime-clean final answers; intrinsic terminal errors are incorrect. No raw runtime failures or retry history contribute to reported measurements.

statistics.estimand: question-weighted mean; paired differences left minus right
statistics.stdev: sample standard deviation; undefined for n<2

interpretation: All latency/cost/token results use only selected runtime-clean attempts. Runtime retries remain separate operational records.
Summed per-question latency is not wall-clock benchmark duration; arms and workers may overlap.
A missing measurement makes a complete-cohort total/mean unavailable. Observed-only statistics are separately labeled.
Pricing estimates use the frozen official OpenAI schedule; the user authorized assuming the same rates for Azure. Actual billed charges are not measured.
Split/exposure results are descriptive. Development used repeated subsets and later designs; the historic split does not certify an untouched test set.
Architecture comparisons include shared tools/contracts and topology; they do not isolate a pure topology effect.

audit_provenance.note: Audit descriptors are retained per question. Full compressed resources/traces were not inflated for this report.

multi_agent.note: Source-check flags are agent diagnostics, not independent proof of answer correctness. Targeted proofs establish local constraints only; draft transitions include all revisions.

operational_context.note: V3 operational wall time includes runtime retries; accepted latency/cost exclude them.
